grants.description: Verify your identity using your GOV.UK One Login credentials to access student finance
grants.purpose: To confirm your identity and link your application to your student finance account

grants.description: Share your university and course details from UCAS with Student Loans Company
grants.purpose: To verify you are enrolled on a qualifying course and calculate your loan entitlement

grants.description: Share your household income information from HMRC to assess your Maintenance Loan entitlement
grants.purpose: To calculate the amount of Maintenance Loan you are entitled to based on household income

grants.description: Request your parent or partner to confirm their income via HMRC for income-assessed Maintenance Loan
grants.purpose: To include parental or partner income in the household income assessment for your Maintenance Loan calculation

grants.description: Access your previous student finance records from SLC to determine remaining funding entitlement
grants.purpose: To calculate how many years of funding you have remaining based on prior study

grants.description: Provide your UK bank account details to receive Maintenance Loan payments
grants.purpose: To pay your Maintenance Loan directly into your bank account at the start of each term

grants.description: Upload supporting evidence for special circumstances (e.g. medical evidence, estrangement evidence, previous study interruption)
grants.purpose: To assess eligibility for maximum funding or special circumstances provisions

revocation.mechanism: Contact Student Loans Company or revoke consent through your online account at any time
revocation.effect: Revoking consent will cancel your application if submitted. Revoking identity or bank details consent will prevent loan payments. You can reapply with renewed consent.

delegation.agent_identity: GOV.UK AI Agent acting on behalf of student applicant
delegation.limitations: Agent CANNOT submit the final application without explicit student confirmation. Agent CANNOT authorize parental or partner income access. Agent CANNOT change bank account details without re-verification. Agent CANNOT accept loan terms and conditions on behalf of the student. Agent CANNOT provide consent for data sharing from HMRC or UCAS - student must do this directly. For estranged students or care leavers, agent CANNOT disclose sensitive circumstances without student permission.
